ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data

promise_gap: Ad: 'Book by 30 Nov 2026 with Rs.1,001; 30% advance due within 7 days of survey and by 7 Dec 2026.' (both ads)

None of this appears on lumisunsolar.com. The home page publishes the subsidy bands only - 1 kW Rs.30,000, 2 kW Rs.60,000, 3 kW and above Rs.78,000 - and there is no per-kW pricing anywhere on the pages read.
Ad: 'Bill-On-Us is the lower of eligible electricity charges or Rs.7 per solar unit generated, capped at Rs.3,000.' (ad of 5 Nov)
There is no Bill-On-Us offer anywhere on the site, and no mention of the Rs.7-per-unit calculation. The only pricing on the pages read is the subsidy table.
Ad: 'Residential 3 kW and 5 kW on-grid systems in Hyderabad, Khammam, Warangal, Karimnagar and Suryapet.'
Backed. The site's own install-map script carries hardcoded coordinates for all five towns plus around a hundred more across Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, and lists Hyderabad as the office.
